Diane — thanks for the doc and the asks. Looping Ben (AE) and Kimberly (legal) to align commercial + legal.

High-level position from Redwood:
- Invoice entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) will issue invoices for hosted services. If Nimbus requires another entity for local tax reasons we can discuss an entity carve-out, but that will need a separate SOW/PO routing.
- Net terms: we typically run Net30 on self-serve customers; for committed order forms we can accept Net45 tied to an approved purchase order. We’re open to Net45 provided the tranche schedule maps to deliverables.
- Proposed compromise on tranches: 40% on signature (execution), 30% at 90 days, 30% at 180 days. Each invoice will include a line-item showing amount applied to minimum commit and a separate line for pre-paid consumption credit.
- Tax/residency: we require a government-issued tax residency certificate to relieve any withholding. If Nimbus withholds, Redwood will treat withheld amounts as taxes payable by the customer unless we have a bilateral treaty/evidence.

I attached a redline of the order form with the tranche language and an example invoice line layout (OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf, OI_pricing_tranches_v2.xlsx).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Nimbus finance confirms whether Net45 is acceptable and provides the PO routing entity.
2) Nimbus shares tax residency docs for entity claiming treaty relief.
3) If Net45 is accepted, Ben & I will route final to Kimberly for a quick legal confirmation and DocuSign.

If you prefer, happy to jump on a 15-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Thanks,
